messages.author: f27d2931061fa7bd
messages.subject: XSS on Shiny Server
parts:
Hi there,
I recently did a Nessus scan of our Shiny Server, and it came up as being XSS vulnerable. There is no reverse proxy on the server. I am running Shiny Server Version 0.4.0.15 and was wondering if there is a way to secure my shiny server from this vulnerability? Would adding NGINX do it? Thank you.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: XSS on Shiny Server
parts:
Would it be possible to send me the report? If there's actually an XSS vulnerability then it's quite unlikely that adding infrastructure in front will solve it--it usually needs to be fixed at the app or server level.

Thanks!
